scope: Twelve distinct non-Native hypotheses; all results retained. Selection uses DEV/CHECK only.

decisions.family: L20: All-R or Q+ASSISTANT x none/both/Decode-only answer bypass
decisions.reason: Complete the prespecified writer/answer-stage matrix without changing pre-answer Image or text Attention updates.
Small DEV recovery justified a limited depth check. All-R/Decode-only L24 entered CHECK; no L28 quality search was warranted.
Coarse diagnostic only; not treated as a physical-handoff speed winner.
Include matched-prompt Native controls. Both lose against original-prompt All-R/Decode-only on full DEV and add text/KV cost; eliminated before CHECK.

selection: All-R/Decode-only L24 had the smallest CHECK worst-dataset point loss, 3.7222pp. Q+ASSISTANT/Decode-only L20 was 0.1667pp behind, within the predeclared 0.25pp tie band, and faster on matched complete sequences. This is not a statistical claim of superior Accuracy.
operational_notes: Initial sparse worktree metadata directory was created before data/source freeze; no shared worktree or main was changed.

One ad-hoc CPU audit command had a shell-quoting SyntaxError. Replaced with the retained historical_gqa_audit module function; 244/244 DEV Native sequences matched. No GPU result or tolerance was changed.
